files.README.md:
# Kilncroft Bindery - plate-cutting job

The job runs under a shared service account and writes plate files and working directories.
The creation rules the operations team uses are carded in ops/create-mode-cards.tsv.

turns.prompt: Kilncroft Bindery runs its plate-cutting job under a shared account. Give the line that leaves the job's account full access to everything the job creates, lets the other members of that account's group read the files and traverse the directories, and gives anyone outside the group no access at all. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
